items: Coach replies now wait for your review before they replace the current advice, and you can undo them.
Settings has a button that erases all of this app's data on this device. Your Google Drive copy is not touched.
The app starts in a light or dark theme to match your device, until you pick one.
Atkinson Hyperlegible is now the default font, and you can change it in Settings.
Structured workouts: built-in sessions, .zwo import, an FTP ramp test and a 20-minute test.
Smart trainers are controlled directly: ERG mode follows workout targets, and Sim mode feels the gradient.
Power zones, categorised climbs with a live climb readout, auto-pause, and recovery of rides cut short by a crash.
Export any ride as a TCX file for Strava or Garmin.
Ride sounds, plus rain, snow, fog and night-ride skies.
